The Fed is telling the market it will keep tightening throughout 2027. Every liquidity metric is going the wrong way for risk, and breadth underneath equities has been horrible. The excessive leverage build-up seen in margin debt and hedge fund gross exposure is reversing quickly, and it's feeding on itself, as history shows it always does. The Nasdaq's drawdown is already half the size of the tariff tantrum's and a third of the 2022 bear market's. Crypto is getting crushed, naturally.

The faster this reset happens, the faster the reversal will come. But that's not an argument made from a position of strength. I've held cash in the @RealVision crypto portfolio since the September-October frothy top, when I highlighted excessive altcoin leverage. Unfortunately, it wasn't enough cushion to offset the fall. Bitcoin's 2026 lows are now definitely under threat, and attention is turning to exhaustion signs.

tweets.text:
Hyperliquid dominates on-chain perps. It traded about $2.5T in the last 12 months, about a third of all on-chain perps volume and 2.6x the next venue. And ICE, owner of the NYSE, has agreed to bring Trade[XYZ]'s hyperliquid:native  -based perp markets onshore in the US. It's becoming critical market infrastructure.

The on-chain economy around it never followed. HyperEVM did about $48B of DEX volume, less than half of Arbitrum.

Kinetiq's (kinetiq:native ) Elysium is the most direct attempt to fix that I've seen. An L2 that settles to HyperEVM, pays gas in HYPE, and links to Hyperliquid's order book in its first upgrade. Half the sequencer fees are meant to buy KNTQ and take it out of circulation, the best L2 token design I've come across.

Apart from proving itself with activity, the major problem is supply. From 27 Nov, 12.9M insider tokens unlock every month for 2 yrs, about 4% of today's float each month. For buybacks to absorb that, Elysium needs more fees than Base earns. After a strong launch week it's making a few thousand dollars a day.

The numbers, the dangerous windows and what would change my mind are in my latest Pro Deep Dive on @RealVision , "Kinetiq (KNTQ): Hyperliquids best shot at a complete L1".
